items.summary: Overall disposition: blocked for public beta or go-live; conditional only for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries. SearchWoot source rights are blocked: Woot documentation confirms API access but not commercial/public redistribution, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, affiliate use, advertising, images, prices, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent launch, monetization, or external permission request. Technical compliance is baseline evidence only: 35 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown; analytics quality is yellow; operations and security sweeps are unavailable; revenue is $4.92 aggregate for 2026-09-21 and not site-attributable. No go-live proposal is supported.

Tracking remains active with 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing progress is evidenced by official API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts. No task is closed because rights, field permissions, retention, deletion/correction/access workflows, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked/private and preview-only. Do not publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, or add dependencies. The concrete next evidence action is a dated packet for each site covering execution ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement, rollback, and an explicit blocker. Reconsider only after the packet and required technical, security, measurement, and legal gates are evidenced.
